channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Reserve Bank of Australia: Growth slowdown supports hold – UOB
item.description: UOB economist Lee Sue Ann notes that softer Australian Gross Domestic Product (GDP), easing inflation and a cooling labour market have reduced pressure on the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) to tighten further.

item.title: ISM Services PMI expected to show weakening expansion
item.description: The Institute for Supply Management (ISM) is scheduled to release the May Services Purchasing Managers Index (PMI) on Wednesday. Market participants anticipate a modest improvement, with the index forecast at 53.8, up from 53.6 in April.

item.title: Eurozone: Pre-emptive ECB tightening – DBS
item.description: DBS Group Research economist Radhika Rao argues that Eurozone markets face a stagflationary shock from US-Iran tensions that will hit Europe harder than the US, pushing the European Central Bank (ECB) to tighten policy earlier.

item.title: Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD tests support at $4,450 as the US Dollar rallies
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) resumed its near-term downtrend on Wednesday, with bears pushing against the intra-week lows at the $4,450 area.

item.title: Oil: Conflict-driven gains test growth hopes – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Bob Savage notes that WTI and Brent prices are rising for a third day as United States (US)-Iran tensions escalate, with missile and drone attacks in the Gulf region pushing benchmarks toward and above USD 90.

item.title: Silver price declines as stronger Dollar, US-Iran tensions weigh on precious metals
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) trades around $74.50 on Wednesday at the time of writing, down 0.88% on the day. The white metal is facing selling pressure as the US Dollar (USD) continues to recover, supported by escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East.

item.title: US Dollar: Fed backdrop and data focus – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad notes that renewed US–Iran tensions have lifted the Dollar, Oil and global bond yields, with a restrictive Federal Reserve (Fed) backdrop seen as supportive for further Dollar strength.

item.title: ECB’s Elderson: Balance of risks has clearly deteriorated
item.description: European Central Bank (ECB) Vice-Chair of the Supervisory Board Frank Elderson said during the European trading session on Wednesday that the balance of risks has clearly deteriorated due to Middle East conflicts.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Tests 1.1600 amid flaring geopolitical tensions, higher Oil prices
item.description: The Euro (EUR) resumed its downtrend against a stronger US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday, with bears testing support at the 1.1600 level.

item.title: Economists expect June ECB rate hike as stagflation risk stays high - Reuters poll
item.description: The European Central Bank (ECB) could tighten monetary policy sooner than previously expected, according to the latest Reuters poll of economists.

item.title: US President Trump: Iran has agreed they will not have a nuclear weapon
item.description: In a podcast interview on Wednesday, US President Donald Trump said that “Iran has agreed they will not have a nuclear weapon.”

item.title: Japanese Yen: BoJ tightening and intervention risks – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank’s Senior FX Strategist Jane Foley discusses USD/JPY’s sharp pullback after comments from PM Takaichi and Bank of Japan (BoJ) Governor Ueda. Foley highlights renewed FX intervention risks, a still-firm US Dollar (USD) and speculation over a June BoJ rate hike.

item.title: “SNB has increased readiness to intervene in forex market”: SNB Schlegel hints at near-term intervention
item.description: Swiss National Bank (SNB) Chairman Martin Schlegel said during the European trading session on Wednesday that the central bank has increased its readiness to intervene in the Forex market.

item.title: Euro holds steady vs British Pound as upgraded PMIs, shared hawkish stance cap moves
item.description: EUR/GBP trades around 0.8635 on Wednesday at the time of writing, with limited movement on the day as investors assess a fresh batch of revised macroeconomic data from the Eurozone and the United Kingdom (UK).

item.title: US Dollar: Services data and labor signals – TD Securities
item.description: TD Securities strategists highlight upcoming US data, expecting the ISM Services Index to rise, supported by new orders and supply chain issues linked to the Iran conflict.

item.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Kiwi dips below 0.5900 in risk-off markets
item.description: The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) depreciates for the third consecutive day against a stronger US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday, hitting lows below 0.5900.

item.title: British Pound: Rate risks support versus Euro – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Derek Halpenny argues that strong United Kingdom (UK) credit and mortgage data, alongside elevated UK front-end yields, support the case for further Bank of England (BoE) tightening.

item.title: Japanese Yen rises sharply against Euro after Takaichi's latest intervention warning
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) reflects a sudden jump against its major currency peers in the European trading session on Wednesday. There is a noticeable uptick in the Asia-Pacific currency against its peer, pushing EUR/JPY over 0.3% down to near 185.40.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) fell on Wednesday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $74.30 per troy ounce, down 1.10% from the $75.13 it cost on Tuesday.

item.title: Iran's Foreign Ministry: Condemns US strikes on Qeshm island
item.description: Iran's Foreign Ministry has stated during the European trading session on Wednesday that it condemns United States (US) strikes on Iranian tanker and Qeshm island.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Gradual pullback within range against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: UOB strategists Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note AUD/USD failed to retest 0.7135 and instead held in a tight 0.7153–0.7187 band, but still sees a soft tone with scope for a drift toward 0.7150.

item.title: Indian Rupee tumbles due to FIIs selling, rising oil prices
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) falls sharply against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday.

item.title: Eurozone and Germany Composite PMIs revised higher: Here’s what it means for EUR/USD
item.description: Eurozone’s HCOB Composite Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) has been revised higher to 48.5 in May, better than the flash reading and estimates of 47.5. This signifies that the overall business activity continues to contract, but at a moderate pace.

item.title: Danish Krone: Record low against Euro tests central bank stance – Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Research Team notes that EUR/DKK hit a new historic high at 7.4739, with the Danish central bank refraining from FX intervention in May. They argue that while the bank shows patience with upward pressure, continued strength would likely prompt action to cap EUR/DKK.

item.title: South African Rand: Gains versus Dollar needs 16.12 break – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale notes the USD/ZAR downtrend has paused after an interim low near 15.63 in January, with the pair struggling to reclaim its 200-day moving average. A recent pivot high around 16.80–16.92 forms key resistance, whose break would confirm a larger bounce.

item.title: Gold refreshes weekly low, below $4,450 as USD sticks to gains on Mideast risks, Fed bets
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) continues to lose ground through the first half of the European session on Wednesday and slides back below the $4,450 level, hitting a fresh weekly low in the last hour.

item.title: Dow Jones futures decline on US-Iran tensions, tech rally fades
item.description: Dow Jones futures decline 0.55% below 49,350, while S&P 500 futures lose 0.09% to near 7,620. Meanwhile, Nasdaq 100 futures inch lower 0.01%, trading near 30,700 during the European hours on Wednesday, ahead of the US regular opening.

item.title: Australian Dollar extends soft GDP-inspired slide; remains confined in range vs USD
item.description: The AUD/USD pair drops to the 0.7150 area during the first half of the European session on Wednesday, reversing the previous day's positive move amid a broadly firmer US Dollar (USD).

item.title: BoJ’s Ueda: Our basic stance is to continue raising interest rates
item.description: Bank of Japan (BoJ) Governor Kazuo Ueda reaffirms that the direction of the monetary policy remains on the upside, while speaking at the Kisaragi-kai Meeting on Wednesday.

item.title: Swiss Franc: Debasement unwind points to losses versus US Dollar – ING
item.description: Chris Turner at ING highlights that last year’s US Dollar (USD) debasement trade favoured the Swiss Franc (CHF), Gold and bitcoin, but a more hawkish Fed view could reverse this.
